steps.en: Offender has settled the warrant of arrest
steps.id: Offender sudah melunasi warrant of arrest
steps.why_en: The portal never checks whether a warrant was settled before this service; only a help text mentions warrants.
steps.why_id: Portal tidak pernah mengecek apakah warrant sudah lunas; hanya ada teks petunjuk yang menyebut warrant.

steps.en: Portal offers a Clearance Slip service page
steps.id: Portal punya halaman layanan Clearance Slip
steps.why_en: No Clearance Slip page or route exists in the portal; only payment and furnish pages are there.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada halaman atau route Clearance Slip di portal; yang ada hanya halaman payment dan furnish.

steps.en: Offender chooses to log in with Singpass
steps.why_en: Singpass login exists but is wired only to payment and furnish, with no Clearance Slip entry.
steps.why_id: Login Singpass sudah ada tapi hanya dipasang untuk payment dan furnish, tanpa pintu masuk Clearance Slip.

steps.en: Portal creates a transaction ID and redirects to Singpass
steps.id: Portal membuat transaction ID lalu mengalihkan ke Singpass
steps.why_en: Generic redirect works, but uses the payment/furnish app ID, not one for Clearance Slip.
steps.why_id: Pengalihan generik jalan, tapi memakai app ID payment/furnish, bukan untuk Clearance Slip.

steps.en: After login, portal receives the offender's ID from Singpass
steps.id: Setelah login, portal menerima ID offender dari Singpass
steps.why_en: ID retrieval works in general, but the real Singpass reply cannot be checked from the code; dev uses a fake ID.
steps.why_id: Pengambilan ID jalan secara umum, tapi balasan Singpass asli tidak bisa dicek dari code; dev memakai ID palsu.

steps.en: Page checks whether a clearance slip can be generated for the offender's ID
steps.id: Halaman mengecek apakah ada clearance slip yang bisa dibuat atas ID offender
steps.why_en: No clearance slip lookup exists; the only slip code prints payment receipts.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengecekan clearance slip; code slip yang ada hanya mencetak receipt pembayaran.
